name: cms-platform
description: Production-grade digital signage, CMS, and IoT platform monorepo

scripts.dev: node infra/scripts/free-dev-ports.mjs && node infra/scripts/dev-stack.mjs turbo run dev --no-update-notifier --output-logs=new-only
scripts.dev:force: node infra/scripts/free-dev-ports.mjs && node infra/scripts/dev-stack.mjs turbo run dev --force --no-update-notifier --output-logs=new-only
scripts.vision-server:up: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile vision-server up -d vision-inference
scripts.vision-server:down: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile vision-server stop vision-inference
scripts.vision-server:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile vision-server logs -f vision-inference
scripts.dev:app: node infra/scripts/free-dev-ports.mjs && node infra/scripts/dev-stack.mjs turbo run dev --filter=@platform/cms --filter=@platform/api --no-update-notifier --output-logs=new-only
scripts.dev:cms-only: node infra/scripts/free-dev-ports.mjs && node infra/scripts/dev-stack.mjs --no-travis turbo run dev --no-update-notifier --output-logs=new-only
